glm_cache.conclusion: RAM-budget sweep did not substantially grow dynamic cache; explicit capacity test required

olmoe.description: Allen AI open mixture-of-experts model; approximately 7B total / 1B active parameters; small caching testbed, not Qwen

qwen_memory.status: blocked: isolated Qwen engine build and benchmark adapter required
qwen_memory.weights: existing Colibri int4 gs64; pin revision and SHA256 before first run

resident_baseline.requirement: Confirm all experts resident and no steady-state expert misses; a large RAM flag alone is insufficient

controls.order: alternate resident and candidate; seeded randomized candidate order
controls.cache: fresh process; record first-use and warmed phases separately; OS page cache uncontrolled
controls.prompts: same sky/code and 24 graded prompts, both styles

safety.lock: .bench.lock; one GPU campaign at a time
safety.engine: isolated engines/ clone; do not build or reconfigure owner engine
safety.memory: preflight estimated peak incl dense/KV/scratch and OS headroom; skip unsafe capacity, record reason; abort on pressure
safety.output: retain raw logs and outputs including failures; mark output mismatches

phases: Build adapter and validate parse/output with one smoke run
Measure capacities that pass memory preflight
Grade every capacity against resident answers; compare same prompts/style
Compare LRU vs LFU/admission and unequal layer allocation at identical actual byte budgets
qwen_memory.publication: One update after campaign completion; no invented results; no claim of full residency without telemetry

glm_cache_experiment.hypothesis: Explicit capacity overrides the Metal fast-SSD cap=1 heuristic and makes larger RAM budgets retain more useful experts
controls: Hold pin set, engine, weights, threads, routing and prompts fixed
Disable expert skipping and cache-aware routing
Enforce projected peak plus safety headroom; skip unsafe capacities
Separate prefill/decode hits, pin/dynamic hits and bytes actually retained
Three repeats, output comparison and identical actual memory budgets for policy comparisons
followups: Frequency-aware admission or protected hot experts, not plain frequency alone
Unequal per-layer allocation by avoided read cost per retained byte
Trace-driven prefetch: measure demand hits and wasted reads separately
Avoid duplicate host/GPU expert copies and repeated packing
glm_cache_experiment.warning: Increasing hit rate is not a win unless measured decode speed improves at acceptable correctness and memory
